name: Low-voltage distribution (415/240 V)
applications: plant LV power at 415 V three-phase / 240 V single-phase
principle: The Malaysian LV level: TNB supplies 415/240 V (also written 400/230 V) three-phase four-wire to premises up to roughly 1,000 kVA via CT metering. Within the installation a main switchboard divides into sub-boards, motor control centres and final circuits; discrimination between breakers and the fault level at each board set the breaking capacities. Per the Electricity Regulations, LV work is done by licensed wiremen/chargemen and needs a Test Certificate (Form H) before TNB energises.
